scope: Frozen design technical review only; no implementation permission, lifecycle verdict or whole-story QA.
frozenHashVerification: Document, design record, story and all eleven sourceSnapshot entries match root freeze.

findings.finding: Frozen ModelObservedQuestion choices allows1..10, whereas the actual observed NEXT_ACTION CLARIFICATION boundary requires2..10. A closed independent witness decoder accepting a coherently rehashed single-alternative question weakens the original model contract.
findings.remediation: Set ModelObservedQuestion choices to2..10 and require the equal ordered server meanings/choices to retain the same cardinality. Keep existing unrelated source/public question behavior unchanged. Re-freeze the bounded design amendment before implementation.
findings.oracle: Start from valid original two-choice captured witness. Remove the unselected alternative consistently from modelQuestion, context.question choices and meanings; recompute modelQuestionHash, meaningsHash, contextIdentityHash, questionCaptureHash and all outer basis/artifact hashes. Both Java and Node must refuse the single-choice witness, while the unaltered two-choice baseline passes.

resolvedSourceGaps.finding: Original question observation can disappear after answer REFRESH; V33 capture previously occurred only at preparation.
resolvedSourceGaps.resolution: Section2 requires original acknowledged question observation captured into existing immutable V33 observation table in the question/model apply transaction before state transition and refresh. No collection or backfill.

resolvedSourceGaps.finding: V32 context lacks a causal attempt/plan association; provider and server question/choice IDs differ.
resolvedSourceGaps.resolution: Prospective immutable questionCapture carries original persisted attempt identity, historical plan/hash and modelQuestionHash, joined to terminalAPPLIED NEXT_ACTION safe_result at publication. No latest-response search.

resolvedSourceGaps.finding: Mutable answer progress is not an immutable historical acceptedAt/actor record.
resolvedSourceGaps.resolution: Nullable immutable preparation receipt snapshots the existing answer as of original preparation; resolvedAt retains original bytes as audit consistency only. Actual accepted_choice and pre-effect insertion prove acceptance was present before effect.

resolvedSourceGaps.finding: Learning applies selected target while publication applies raw intent; multiple accepted questions currently have iteration-order ambiguity.
resolvedSourceGaps.resolution: Independent Java/Node derive only targetIntent/selectedLocator from proved explicit human target resolution; raw plan/operation/input/read/binding/scope remain unchanged. Multiple accepted observed questions for one obligation refuse; no timestamp supersession.

existing: V32 session-scoped primary key and translation-state FK; context identity/meanings immutable; accepted_choice nullable single assignment, directSQL membership check; no plan/model-attempt FK or historical actor/acceptedAt.
V32 terminal model attempt identity/safe_result immutable and plans immutable; source/model associations in JSON still need explicit application joins.
V33 observation capture locks session, checks current progress body/canonical hash and400/1MiB aggregate caps; preparations/admissions retain scoped relational joins and immutable rows.
newDDLConditions: Add nullable observed_choice_receipt only to unshipped V33 publication preparations; ordinary/old NULL rows remain valid and unmodified.

CHECK must use observed_choice_receipt IS NULL OR (complete closed typed receipt AND complete closed typed answer AND exact row session/preparation match AND bounds) IS TRUE. JSON null must not pass as SQL NULL; missing keys, wrong scalar types, extras and null required nested fields refuse. bindingId is the only declared nullable answer field.
Use canonical UTF8 receipt limit16384 with the existing canonical function; verify nested IDs/hashes/coordinate/generation/revisions and original ISO instant without rewriting timestamp bytes.

Existing whole-row deny-update/delete trigger must cover receipt; attempts to fill a previously NULL receipt after preparation must fail. No new nullable loophole permits application publication because accepted-row completeness requires the original witness.
applicationOnlyConditions: Same-session originalCALLING attempt/current immutableplan/current materialization/current observation joins are validated before question create; terminalAPPLIED response and historical plan are independently validated when reading. No JSON FK is claimed.
Existing authenticated clarify source/generation/expiry checks and accepted_choice are authority; mutable resolvedAt alone never supplies authority or chronology.

Under session/source lock, preparation captures exactly one accepted observed decision, exact context/mappings/answer and proposal locator before admission. Exporter checks all actual accepted observed rows for complete successful witnessed associations.
Node cannot discover an omitted same-target database decision; that completeness oracle belongs real Java/DB exporter, not a fabricated standalone basis claim.

mandatoryImplementationOracles: Atomic rollback at question context creation, original observation capture and APPLIED model settlement; no orphan retained question/capture or caller-selected attempt.
DirectSQL receipt extra/missing/null/type/count/byte/scope mutations; originalNULL rows accepted; nonnull receipt update/delete/backfill refused; source V30–32 unchanged.

Valid two-choice original question, accepted alternate locator, later fresh preparation generation/node and immutable action association. Raw target differing from selected target is expected human resolution, not a rejection by invented English grammar.
Wrong source/config/scope/worker/fence/context/attempt/status/kind/plan/hash/obligation/choice/old node/fresh locator/prep/action refuses with unchanged valid baseline first.

Duplicate meanings/choiceIds/accepted observed questions, unaccepted/missing capture, missing historical observation, missing preparation receipt, and same-target witness omission fail closed. No implicit latest-wins.
Historical immutable question plan matching unchanged final obligation succeeds; actual altered obligation/read/input/binding/operation/predicate cannot be rewritten by meaning metadata.

Every witness hash and exact ordered provider-meaning/server-mapping correspondence independently verified; observation pool exactly union of successful preparation and selected question evidence, no extras.

Real controlled public observed-phase answer after delay beyond browser timeout, preserved through refresh and actual pure publication; two recorded fresh-value model-free ordinary replays with independent chosen/unchosen destination assertions and one submit per explicit run. No source-question replacement or fake callback.
compatibilityAndPrivacy: Optional internal PreparationFact.observedChoice omitted entirely for zero/source-only paths; preserve their canonical bytes and existing executable Profile. No public/model/IPC DTO expansion.
Old accepted observed choice without prospective capture or immutable preparation witness refuses even if target matches raw plan; no migration backfill.

Coordinate regenerated schema bundle/build catalog and required transport handshake; old decoder must not ignore witness; saved compatible artifacts/replay and historical receipt reading remain supported.

Positive bounded witness projection excludes full prompts, resolved config/secret/runtime values/account handles; projectionHash is opaque historical identity. Provider labels/IDs remain audit-only, never selectors/arguments or diagnostics.
Witness262144bytes, max200, aggregate8MiB, observation400/1MiB caps all remain independently enforced.
